fields.label: Workflow Name
fields.description: Names the workflow for operators; every Instance and log references it by this name.

fields.label: Lifecycle State
fields.description: The Definition's editorial lifecycle, advanced only through its transition verbs (never edited by hand): Draft (authoring, mutable) -> Publish freezes an immutable Version -> Activate arms the entry trigger -> Suspend disarms it -> Archive retires it. A new Instance starts only while Active; running Instances stay pinned to their Version across every later transition.

fields.label: Entry Node
fields.description: The node a Run starts at. The Trigger node declares the subject, the event and the predicate — the workflow header no longer carries them.

fields.label: Trigger Doctype
fields.description: DERIVED from the Trigger node on save, never authored. The dispatcher runs on every document save, so 'which workflows care about this (doctype, event)?' has to be one indexed query — a predicate in JSON cannot answer that. One writer: the Workflow controller.

fields.label: Trigger Event
fields.description: DERIVED from the Trigger node on save, never authored. See trigger_doctype.

fields.label: Trigger Mode
fields.description: Derived from the Trigger node — how a run is born. Record Event, or Schedule for a cohort.

fields.label: Next Cohort Run
fields.description: Derived. When this workflow's cohort is next due. Blank on a record-event workflow, which is woken by a save and is never due.

fields.label: Cohort State
fields.description: Draining while a cohort walk holds this workflow. The atomic claim that stops two sweeps draining one cohort twice.

fields.label: Cohort Cursor
fields.description: The last lead this cohort started, so a killed worker resumes after it instead of from the top. Keyset, never OFFSET.

fields.label: Abort Cohort
fields.description: Stops the current cohort at the next chunk boundary. Runs already started are left alone — cancelling one lead's journey is a different action.

fields.label: Canvas Layout (JSON)
fields.description: UI-only: node positions and viewport for the Campaigns canvas. Not read by the version freeze, so moving a node never mints a new Version; layout is presentation, the node graph is content.

fields.label: Trigger Vertical
fields.description: DERIVED from the Trigger node on save, never authored. The dispatcher runs on every document save and filters on these, so they must be indexed columns — a declaration inside JSON cannot answer that. One writer: the Workflow controller.

fields.description: DERIVED from the Trigger node on save, never authored. The dispatcher runs on every document save and filters on these, so they must be indexed columns — a declaration inside JSON cannot answer that. One writer: the Workflow controller.
